user_story: As a user, I want to filter tasks by category so that I can focus on a specific area.

positive.title: Filter tasks by valid category
steps: Select a valid category from the filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: Tasks belonging to the selected category are displayed.

positive.title: Filter tasks and check task count
steps: Select a valid category from the filter dropdown
positive.expected_result: The number of tasks displayed matches the expected count for the selected category.

positive.title: Reset filter to show all tasks
steps: Select a category from the filter dropdown

negative.title: Filter tasks by invalid category
steps: Select an invalid category from the filter dropdown
negative.expected_result: No tasks are displayed, and an appropriate error message is shown indicating the category is invalid.

negative.title: Filter tasks without selection
negative.expected_result: All tasks are displayed without any filtering applied.

edge.title: Filter tasks with a very large number of categories
steps: Select a category from a dropdown that lists 1000 categories
edge.expected_result: Tasks belonging to the selected category are displayed without performance issues.

edge.title: Rapidly change category selection
steps: Select a category from filter dropdown
edge.expected_result: Tasks belonging to the most recently selected category are displayed correctly.
